label: Passerby
description: A street photographer's cast of strangers — ordinary adults mid-life, each carrying their occupation and story in clothing, posture and props. Night-shift characters are tagged night.

items.name: bike-courier
items.text: a bike courier in a rain-slicked shell jacket, radio clipped to the chest strap, a fixed-gear bike leaned against one hip, courier bag heavy across the back
items.text_short: a bike courier, shell jacket, fixed-gear bike

items.name: pigeon-gentleman
items.text: an elderly gentleman in a pressed three-piece suit scattering seed for a churn of pigeons, hat brim low, a cane hooked over one forearm
items.text_short: an elderly suited gentleman feeding pigeons

items.name: flower-seller
items.text: a flower seller in a canvas apron hauling zinc buckets of cut tulips onto the pavement, petals stuck to her wet forearms
items.text_short: a flower seller with zinc buckets of tulips

items.name: street-violinist
items.text: a street violinist mid-phrase with eyes closed, instrument case open at her feet, loose coins and a single folded note catching the light
items.text_short: a street violinist mid-phrase, open case at her feet

items.name: cook-smoke-break
items.text: a line cook in stained whites on a smoke break, back against the alley brick, one knee bent, apron strings hanging loose
items.text_short: a line cook in whites on an alley smoke break

items.name: commuter-umbrella
items.text: a businesswoman mid-stride under a black umbrella, phone pressed between ear and shoulder, coat belt trailing behind her
items.text_short: a businesswoman under a black umbrella, phone at her ear

items.name: newspaper-reader
items.text: a man in a worn overcoat reading a folded newspaper at the bus stop, a leather satchel wedged between his ankles
items.text_short: a man reading a folded newspaper at the bus stop

items.name: skater
items.text: a skateboarder in a faded hoodie carving a slow line between pedestrians, grip tape worn pale at the tail

items.name: fishmonger
items.text: a fishmonger in rubber boots and a wet apron laying silver mackerel across fresh ice, steel scaling knife tucked in the apron tie
items.text_short: a fishmonger in rubber boots arranging mackerel on ice

items.name: night-nurse
items.text: a nurse in creased scrubs at the end of a night shift, lanyard and paper coffee cup in one hand, dawn light on tired features
items.text_short: a night-shift nurse with coffee, tired in dawn light

items.name: hotel-doorman
items.text: a uniformed doorman under a hotel canopy, white gloves and double rows of brass buttons catching the lamplight, posture parade-straight
items.text_short: a uniformed hotel doorman under the canopy

items.name: dog-walker
items.text: a dog walker tangled in six taut leads, arm crossed over arm, the pack pulling in three directions at once
items.text_short: a dog walker tangled in six leads

items.name: window-cleaner
items.text: a window cleaner halfway up a ladder, squeegee raised, a sheet of soap water sliding down the glass in front of his face
items.text_short: a window cleaner on a ladder, soap sheeting down the glass

items.name: umbrella-couple
items.text: a couple pressed together under one small umbrella, his jacket draped over her shoulders, both laughing at the rain
items.text_short: a couple sharing one umbrella, laughing at the rain
